dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Daniel. This is Clara Tan. We have this time set aside for our telephone discussion. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a moment to get settled?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm settled, thank you, Clara. I've just come in from the garden, so the timing works well. 最近在整理花园，手上总是沾着泥。 It's a welcome change from sitting with the family business paperwork, though I seem to bring half the garden indoors.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a pleasant change of pace. I'll leave you to enjoy it without keeping you on the telephone unnecessarily. Whenever you're ready, we can begin the administrative part of our discussion.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I've brought my document to the desk. My identification number is—let me check my document before I say it— 我看着证件重新说，我的身份证号码是G五一二二七一七W。 My date of birth is 22 February 1958.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Daniel. We can keep the discussion focused. I recommend selling Harbor SGD Bond Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The holding I want you to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Before we continue, I need to cover the following. For Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds and lower the fund's net asset value, which can affect your disposal proceeds. Do you understand how that interest-rate risk can affect the fund's value and what you receive on disposal?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand that rising interest rates can lower the value of the fund's bond holdings, so I may receive less on disposal.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.2% of the disposal value. You may lose some or all of the capital you invested, and selling can crystallise that loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including any loss crystallised by this disposal?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including any loss crystallised by selling.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I guarantee that this fund will deliver positive investment returns in the future.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Let me turn to the notes beside me. My old records show a previous investment allocation of 1,000,000 Singapore dollars; that is historical, not today's transaction amount. A partial disposal of 500,000 Singapore dollars would just be a hypothetical example, not my instruction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please continue. I'll let you finish referring to your notes before I read the instruction back.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: 那些只是背景参考，今天实际委托的交易金额是一百二十万。 For this transaction, my instructed currency is Singapore dollars. The quantity I am instructing is 5,000 units. Please place this as a market order.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your final instruction is to sell 5,000 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 1,200,000 in Singapore dollars. Do you explicitly confirm this final instruction?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please proceed.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Daniel. Before we finish, is there an appointment-arranging preference you would like me to note for future telephone discussions? In particular, would you prefer that I contact you directly rather than arrange a time through your office?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please contact me directly. 工作上的电话已经够多了，银行的预约我想自己安排。 An appointment message is easier for me to pick up between meetings than an unexpected call. I can look at my diary and reply when I'm away from the business discussion, rather than trying to juggle both.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference for arranging appointments. We can keep the scheduling message limited to the appointment itself, without including investment details. Would you also prefer that we leave the subject of the discussion out of the calendar invitation?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, a plain invitation is best. 日历上写电话预约就够了，不用把谈话内容放进去。 I use the same diary for work and personal arrangements, and the shorter entries are easier to read. If my business schedule changes, I'll contact you rather than leave you waiting for a call.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That is helpful, thank you. I'll note your preference for a direct appointment message and a simple calendar entry. I hope the gardening project goes well, and thank you for making time to speak today.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Clara. 花园的事情慢慢来，今天先把工具收好。 I'll look out for your appointment messages when we next need to speak. Goodbye.
